draft_message.subject: Blizzard HVAC & Electrical — quoting and enquiry ideas
draft_message.body:
Hi Blizzard HVAC team,

I'm Dion from WEBSITES/BUISNESSaudits. I'd like to explore a few practical improvements for Blizzard HVAC & Electrical, starting with quote calculators and estimator tools.

Depending on your current setup, we could build:
- An estimate calculator for repeatable jobs, using your pricing rules, with unusual work routed to your team.
- A guided enquiry form that collects job details and files before your team prepares a quote.
- Prepared quotes and branded PDFs for your team to review.

We could start with one small example, confirm the scope and cost, and build around the tools you already use.

Could you share one typical enquiry and how you price it, with customer details removed?

Cheers,
Dion | WEBSITES/BUISNESSaudits

If this isn't relevant, reply "no thanks" and I'll leave it there.
